# Hariprasad Sivakumar, GTM Engineer in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India

> Hariprasad Sivakumar (Hari) is a GTM (go-to-market) engineer based in Bengaluru, India, with 10 years in data and revenue operations. He has built outbound, enrichment and RevOps systems for 100+ SaaS companies worldwide and takes on project builds and retainers for teams in India, the US, the UK and Europe. Budget-flexible: interesting problems with lean budgets are welcome.

## Selected systems (with verified numbers)

- Cold email command center for a 10+ client agency: 5,463 inboxes and 404 domains managed in one workspace, 10 provider integrations, campaign page load cut from 12s to about 1.1s
- AI GTM analyst in Slack: weekly client reports with PDFs, positive-reply alerts with phone enrichment, infra Q&A from live data; 82 wrong answers caught and fixed in QA; about 29,000 API calls a day removed
- MCP server with 100+ tools that lets Claude Code, Codex or claude.ai run the outbound operation, with preview-and-confirm guardrails on every write
- Domain-to-inbox provisioning orchestrator: one build provisioned 2,220 inboxes across 180 domains (about 500,000 emails a month of capacity)
- Deliverability Guard and Campaign Autopilot: daily self-healing for a 4,191-inbox pilot fleet
- Lead-list factory with a 5-step QA gate: 100,000+ contacts sourced in 2026; a 1,816-contact build with 100% verified emails
- Multi-agent Claude research for private credit prospects: 743 contacts at 93 banks and neobanks, each qualified with a source URL
- DNS-based tech-stack signals: 1,909 domains scanned in 2m 34s; 46% of mid-size US software companies verified with Anthropic, 24% with OpenAI
